purpose: Official inventory of technical certificates and security profiles used or evaluated by Node Core OS. Product security profiles are not installable X.509 certificates.

technical_certificates.name: Lobby loopback HTTPS
technical_certificates.purpose: Encrypt the local browser-to-Lobby connection on localhost and 127.0.0.1.
technical_certificates.trust_model: Self-signed local certificate; browser trust is separate and requires user/platform action.
technical_certificates.required_for: HTTPS transport to the local Lobby; not required for Node Core OS core operation.

technical_certificates.name: Node Core OS P2P identity certificate
technical_certificates.purpose: Bind the node's Ed25519 public key and NODE ID for explicitly pinned P2P TLS 1.3.
technical_certificates.trust_model: Explicit peer pinning; not a public Web PKI certificate.
technical_certificates.required_for: Native P2P when that service is enabled; the Lobby must not rotate or replace it.

technical_certificates.name: Node Core OS trusted peer certificate store
technical_certificates.type: Local trust registry of public X.509 peer certificates
technical_certificates.manager: Node Core OS core; Lobby administrative interface
technical_certificates.purpose: Explicit allowlist and revocation status for remote Node Core OS peer certificates.
technical_certificates.trust_model: Operator verifies peer NODE ID and SHA-256 fingerprint out of band before trust.
technical_certificates.required_for: Native P2P connections to explicitly trusted peers.

technical_certificates.name: Node Core OS signed identity credential
technical_certificates.location: Issued credential and external issuer trust configuration
technical_certificates.purpose: Portable signed identity/profile claims; not an X.509 certificate.
technical_certificates.trust_model: Explicit trusted issuer public key and issuer-ID binding; revocation data supplied by deployment.
technical_certificates.required_for: Only workflows that explicitly issue or verify Node Core OS identity credentials.

technical_certificates.name: Node Core OS Web TLS identity binding
technical_certificates.type: Ed25519-signed binding to an externally issued X.509 certificate
technical_certificates.manager: Node Core OS core / external Web PKI
technical_certificates.location: Deployment-managed web certificate and signed binding
technical_certificates.purpose: Bind a node identity to an exact DNS name and the fingerprint of an already-issued TLS certificate.
technical_certificates.trust_model: Web PKI chain and browser trust are checked independently from the Node Core OS signature.
technical_certificates.required_for: Only when a node publishes a public HTTPS DNS service.
